title: Longest common subsequence with a DP table
summary: The table for ABCBDAB and BDCABA is filled row by row from smaller answers; the LCS length and one LCS are read from it.

entities.text: Longest common subsequence of ABCBDAB and BDCABA?

beats.title: The question
beats.narration: A subsequence keeps letters in order but may skip some. What is the longest one both strings share?
